if (NOT EMSCRIPTEN)
    add_subdirectory (GLEW)
endif ()
add_subdirectory (STB)
add_subdirectory (Tracy)

# SDL3
add_definitions (-DSDL_LEAN_AND_MEAN=1)
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL_DOCS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_DISABLE_STB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Disable everything we don't care about.
set(SDL_TIMERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_ATOMIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_VULKAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_RENDER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_HAPTIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_POWER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_FILE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_CPUINFO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_FILESYSTEM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_SENSOR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_LOCALE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_MISC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_CAMERA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_GPU OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory (SDL)

set_property(TARGET SDL3-static PROPERTY FOLDER "ThirdParty")
set_property(TARGET STB PROPERTY FOLDER "ThirdParty")

# Jolt
set(JPH_USE_DX12 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(JPH_USE_VK OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(JPH_USE_MTL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(JPH_USE_CPU_COMPUTE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPP_RTTI_ENABLED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SSE4_1 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SSE4_2 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX2 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_AVX512 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_LZCNT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_TZCNT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_F16C OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_FMADD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory (Jolt)

set_property(TARGET Jolt PROPERTY FOLDER "ThirdParty")
